_comment: The boot eye's geometry, in the 800x480 design frame (design/boot/, A′: the eye says hi). The single source for the app's boot screen (BootScreen.vue), the first frame inlined into index.html (vite.config.ts), the Plymouth theme's images (kiosk/boot/make-plymouth.py) and the boot cover (kiosk/boot/cover.py). Every screen size scales this by min(width/800, height/480) around its center. now_tab is the Now tab's icon (src/shell/AppShell.vue, a 24 box) that the eye lands in.
